rules.guidance: Don't use a mutable default argument (`def f(x=[])`) — it's shared across calls. Use `None` + create inside.
Avoid bare `except:` / `except Exception` that swallows; catch specific exceptions or re-raise with context.
Open files/sockets/locks with a `with` context manager so they're closed on every path.
Never build SQL/shell with f-strings/`%` from untrusted input — use parameterized queries / `subprocess` lists.
Public functions carry type hints; avoid `Any` where a concrete type is known.
In async code, don't call blocking I/O/CPU work directly — use `await`/executors so the loop isn't blocked.
Don't use `assert` for runtime validation (stripped with -O); raise explicit errors.
